Staging (test builds): vault release log

Staging release 18 (test build)

Release 18 makes staging's waits 24 times shorter for testing, and counts wrong PINs and passwords consistently in credential changes.

Status

Status
Active
Published
2026-10-19
End date
Not set

The current release. New vaults are enrolled into it, and the app offers it to everyone on an older release.

Changes

  • Staging only: waits of an hour or more run 24 times faster, so a day is an hour. The daily check comes every hour and a recovery's quiet period is 3 hours. Production is unchanged.
  • A wrong PIN or password while changing your password, setting up your credential or deleting your vault now counts toward your daily check's limit, as it already did at unlock.
  • Changing your password, deleting your vault and approving a move check that your phone holds the current credential before they test your PIN, so an outdated copy never uses an attempt.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 07bf770 (tag release/staging/18) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-19 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix
